home.intro: Since 2019, I’ve been building modern, scalable, and user-focused web applications — from React interfaces to the services that stand behind them.
home.about: I’m an informatics engineer and web developer with 7+ years of experience — from graphic design to production-ready code. React and TypeScript are my core stack, and I combine creativity with technical expertise to deliver complete, well-crafted digital products. Right now I’m working on a large-scale recruitment platform, where I build AI-powered product features, real-time functionality, and product analytics & experimentation — primarily on the React frontend, and increasingly on the .NET services behind it — while also supporting the UI/UX process. In my own projects I build the whole stack myself, with Node.js, Express and Sequelize over PostgreSQL and MySQL. I’m looking for a full-stack role where I can grow and build meaningful projects.
home.projDesc1: Below is a selection of projects I've developed — both commercial and personal. Click More to read about the project in detail and access a live demo, if available.

projects.title: Projects

stepstoneApply.title: StepStone Apply
stepstoneApply.desc: The job-application platform behind one of Europe's largest job marketplaces, serving millions of users — a React and Next.js frontend over .NET microservices and PostgreSQL.
stepstoneApply.descLong: I develop complex product features with a focus on performance, usability, and maintainability, managing server and client state with TanStack Query and Redux, integrating real-time functionality via WebSockets, and safeguarding quality with unit tests (Vitest) and end-to-end tests (Playwright). My highlight contribution is AI Talent Assessment — an AI-powered feature that generates qualification questions tailored to each job offer, streamed to candidates in real time and integrated into selected application flows, helping employers better evaluate candidate skills. I also work with Amplitude for product analytics and experimentation, and implement web analytics tracking with Tealium and Adobe Analytics based on specifications from our analytics team. Alongside the frontend work I also take on back-end tasks in the .NET BFF and microservices — extending API endpoints and data contracts, and working with the PostgreSQL-backed persistence behind them — which lets me follow a feature through the whole stack rather than stopping at the API boundary. I work closely with backend engineers, product managers, designers, and analysts, integrate the frontend with backend services and APIs, and use Claude Code as part of my daily workflow — including AI-assisted development workflows that integrate Claude Code with Playwright for automated end-to-end verification — while contributing to code reviews and the continuous improvement of our frontend practices.
stepstoneApply.role: My role: Software Engineer — frontend-focused, with back-end feature work
challenges: Building scalable, responsive interfaces in a high-traffic environment serving millions of users
Delivering complex product features within a microservices and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture
Managing server-state and client-state with TanStack Query and Redux
Integrating real-time functionality with WebSockets to power AI-driven product features
Delivering AI Talent Assessment — AI-generated, job-tailored qualification questions woven into selected application flows
Implementing product analytics and experimentation with Amplitude, and web analytics tracking with Tealium and Adobe Analytics
Ensuring quality through unit testing (Vitest) and end-to-end testing (Playwright)
Designing AI-assisted development workflows that integrate Claude Code with Playwright for automated end-to-end verification
Integrating the frontend with numerous backend services and APIs
Taking on back-end tasks in .NET services — API endpoints, data contracts and PostgreSQL persistence — alongside the React frontend
Collaborating with backend engineers, product managers, designers, analysts, and other stakeholders

fakturownia.title: Fakturownia/Invoice Ocean
fakturownia.desc: The most popular invoicing software in Poland, trusted by over 600 000 businesses.
fakturownia.descLong: I worked on modernising and unifying an interface with a long development history, and on designing and implementing new features across a large legacy codebase.
fakturownia.role: My role: UI/UX design, front-end feature implementation
challenges: Getting up to speed with a large, legacy codebase
Thorough modernization of the UI and unification of an interface with a long development history
Navigating a hybrid architecture: building front-end views in Ruby on Rails while developing new features in React
Balancing old and new technologies to ensure smooth integration

onlineAccounting.title: Online Accounting
onlineAccounting.desc: An accounting module for Fakturownia, also designed to work as a standalone application integrated with KSeF. Tailored for sole proprietors.
onlineAccounting.descLong: The product is now publicly available — self-service online accounting that guides users through their PIT, VAT, and ZUS settlements and JPK submissions, with clear deadlines and reminders.
onlineAccounting.role: My role: primarily front-end development, early-stage involvement in UI/UX design (before a dedicated designer joined)
challenges: Displaying and processing multiple types of data in single views
Designing a user-friendly interface for people unfamiliar with accounting concepts
Supporting a wide variety of user needs
Maintaining UI/UX consistency with Fakturownia, which was also undergoing a redesign
Managing a broad scope of responsibilities—from partial UI design to front-end technical details
Coordinating work effectively between the Księgosoft team and the evolving Fakturownia project

boutique.title: Boutique
boutique.desc: An e-commerce website for a fictional women’s clothing brand, featuring product categories, filtering, guest checkout, and Stripe payments. Emphasis on smooth UX and secure, scalable architecture with SEO in mind.
boutique.descLong: I built it as a deep dive into Next.js and server-side rendering — data fetching and caching strategies, the App Router, and SEO — on top of a Node.js, Express and Sequelize API with a MySQL database that I designed and implemented myself.
challenges: Efficiently managing numerous products and categories
Visually appealing and user-friendly product presentation
Fully responsive design
Planning for future admin features such as product/category/collection management
Securely collecting and handling order and payment data
High-performance state management
Optimizing the app for SEO with server-side rendering (SSR)

thisPortfolio.title: This Portfolio
thisPortfolio.desc: Personal portfolio built end to end — a bilingual Next.js App Router frontend with a server-side contact pipeline behind it.
thisPortfolio.descLong: Locale routing is resolved in middleware, styling combines SCSS modules with Tailwind, and the contact form runs through a Next.js API route with zod validation and Resend for delivery. Designed, built and deployed by me.
